flowVariables.name: SPACE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira project key containing agreement issues. Only issues in this project are sent to Signicat.

flowVariables.name: SIGNICAT_BASE_URL
flowVariables.instruction: Signicat API host for the target account or environment.

flowVariables.name: SIGNICAT_CREATE_SIGNATURE_PATH
flowVariables.instruction: Signicat API path that creates and sends a signature request from a template. Adjust the request body and response id JSONPath if your endpoint differs.

flowVariables.name: SIGNICAT_TEMPLATE_ID
flowVariables.instruction: Signicat template ID used to create the agreement signature request.

flowVariables.name: SIGNICAT_SIGNER_ROLE_NAME
flowVariables.instruction: Signicat signer role name used by the configured template, if supported by the provider.

flowVariables.name: SIGNICAT_WEBHOOK_URL
flowVariables.instruction: Paste the trigger URL from the Signicat Incoming Status flow after it is created.
